sections.label: The story of your project this year

content.text:
During this reporting period, we delivered the project with a clear community focus on improved community wellbeing and safe local access. The work was rooted in creating a space where families and young people could feel less isolated and more secure in their local area.

Across the year, the differences we were working towards were consistent: families being more connected, young people having safe access, and volunteers gaining confidence through their involvement. Taken together, these outcomes described the main story of the project this year and the change we were seeking to support in the community.

We should also be clear that the submitted records did not include a budget compared with actual spend summary for this section. For that reason, we have not added any financial comparison here that we cannot evidence.

Those differences were improved community wellbeing and safe local access, alongside families being more connected, young people having a safe place to access, and volunteers gaining confidence.

However, the submitted records did not include examples showing how people from the community shaped decisions during the reporting period. sections.label: The story of your project this year

content.text:
During this reporting period, we delivered the project with a clear community focus on improved community wellbeing and safe local access. The work was rooted in creating a space where families and young people could feel less isolated and more secure in their local area.

Across the year, the differences we were working towards were consistent: families being more connected, young people having safe access, and volunteers gaining confidence through their involvement. Taken together, these outcomes described the main story of the project this year and the change we were seeking to support in the community.

We should also be clear that the submitted records did not include a budget compared with actual spend summary for this section. For that reason, we have not added any financial comparison here that we cannot evidence.

However, the submitted records did not include examples showing how people from the community shaped decisions during the reporting period. sections.label: The story of your project this year

content.text:
During this reporting period, we delivered the project with a clear community focus on improved community wellbeing and safe local access. The work was rooted in creating a space where families and young people could feel less isolated and more secure in their local area.

Across the year, the differences we were working towards were consistent: families being more connected, young people having safe access, and volunteers gaining confidence through their involvement. Taken together, these outcomes described the main story of the project this year and the change we were seeking to support in the community.

We should also be clear that the submitted records did not include a budget compared with actual spend summary for this section. For that reason, we have not added any financial comparison here that we cannot evidence.

sections.label: How you involved people from your community

content.text:
We involved people from our community by keeping our work focused on the differences we said we wanted to make locally. Those differences were improved community wellbeing and safe local access, alongside families being more connected, young people having a safe place to access, and volunteers gaining confidence.

The records available for this progress update showed that we had planned to gather parent or carer feedback as part of how community voice was heard, with a target of 20 feedback comments. This indicated that listening to families formed part of our approach to involving the community in the project.

However, the submitted records did not include examples showing how people from the community shaped decisions during the reporting period. They also did not include named examples of local partners or collaboration activity. Because of that, we have not added detail that we can't evidence from the records currently available.

sections.label: What you learned

content.text:
During this reporting period, our learning remained anchored in the project’s intended focus on improved community wellbeing and safe local access. We also continued to understand progress through the differences we were making for families, young people and volunteers: families being more connected, young people having safe access, and volunteers gaining confidence.

At the same time, the submitted records did not include enough completed learning evidence for us to give a fuller retrospective account of what worked best, what did not work as expected, any unexpected findings, or what would be most useful for others to learn from our experience. We have therefore avoided drawing conclusions that were not supported by the available evidence.

Based on the information held for this progress update, we can say that our reflection stayed closely tied to the original aims of reducing isolation, providing a safe space, and supporting volunteer confidence. However, exact examples and documented learning points were not available in the submitted material for this section.

During this reporting period, we kept our focus on improved community wellbeing and safe local access. We also continued to work toward families being connected, young people having safe access, and volunteers gaining confidence.

However, the submitted records for this progress update did not include enough confirmed evidence to describe specific changes we made to delivery during the period. They also did not set out any documented planned changes or any support needs. Because of that, we have not added detail that cannot be evidenced from the material available.

sections.label: The story of your project this year

content.text:
During this reporting period, we delivered the project with a clear community focus on improved community wellbeing and safe local access. The work was rooted in creating a space where families and young people could feel less isolated and more secure in their local area.

Across the year, the differences we were working towards were consistent: families being more connected, young people having safe access, and volunteers gaining confidence through their involvement. Taken together, these outcomes described the main story of the project this year and the change we were seeking to support in the community.

We should also be clear that the submitted records did not include a budget compared with actual spend summary for this section. For that reason, we have not added any financial comparison here that we cannot evidence.
